introSummary: IGCSE tutors in Sector 111 Gurugram work with Grade 9 and Grade 10 students at the international schools nearby, where option blocks are chosen in Grade 8 and the two-year course begins almost immediately. Support covers Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel subject codes, coursework windows set by each school, and paper technique for the written series. Families across Sobha City, Puri Diplomatic Greens, ATS Triumph and ATS Kocoon can request home visits where travel is realistic, with online sessions used for the subjects few local tutors teach.

contentBlocks.heading: What the schools around Sector 111 Gurugram expect from a Grade 9 student
contentBlocks.body:
The international schools serving this part of the city front-load Grade 9. Subject choices are made during Grade 8, the two-year course begins almost immediately, and by the second term a student is expected to work from a syllabus document rather than from the next chapter of a textbook. That shift catches out plenty of capable children, especially ones who arrived from a school where the teacher decided everything that mattered.

The expectations are specific and rarely spelled out to parents. Independent note-taking. Deadlines that nobody chases. Extended written answers in subjects the student thinks of as science. A Grade 9 report at these schools often carries a predicted grade, which alarms families in December of the first year rather than in the second, when there would still be time to react calmly.

Tutoring here is most useful at exactly that point, before a deficit hardens into a list of missed topics. A tutor working with a Grade 9 student on reading a syllabus, keeping a question bank and writing a six-mark answer is doing more for the eventual result than one arriving in February of Grade 10 to teach content at speed. Not every family sees it that way, and a late start is still worth making.
items: Option choices fixed in Grade 8, course starting straight away
Syllabus documents replacing textbook chapters
Predicted grades appearing on the first Grade 9 report
Extended writing expected in science subjects
Grade 9 habits worth more per hour than Grade 10 catch-up

contentBlocks.heading: From enquiry to tutor for a family in Sector 111
contentBlocks.body:
Think of it as two lists. What you control, and what gets checked on your behalf.

You control the brief. The subjects and their codes, the board, the school, the grade, the specific worry, and the hours that genuinely exist after school and activities. You also control how honest that brief is. A parent who reports that Biology is fine because the school gave a B, when the child cannot write a six-mark answer, gets a tutor solving the wrong problem for a month.

The platform controls the filtering. Tutor identity and qualifications. Teaching history at paper level rather than subject level. Whether the tutor has actually taught the board in question. And whether a home visit to Sector 111 is realistic at the hour requested, rather than simply agreed to on a phone call by someone who has not thought about the drive.

A shortlist follows, usually two or three names, each confirmed as available before you hear about them. You speak to them. You are welcome to sit in on the first session. If the fit is wrong, the shortlist is revised at no cost, and it is entirely normal for the second attempt to be the one that works. Availability is never presented as fixed, because schedules along this corridor change week to week.
items: Your brief: codes, board, school, grade, real free hours
Our filter: identity, qualifications, paper-level history
Travel to Sector 111 tested for realism, not just agreed
Two or three confirmed names, never one
Revised shortlist at no cost if the match is wrong

contentBlocks.heading: Option blocks: the IGCSE subjects Sector 111 students pick and regret
contentBlocks.body:
Option blocks decide more than parents realise, and the decision gets taken in Grade 8 by a student who has never seen the paper.

Triple science against Combined Science 0654 is the first fork. Three separate sciences means three sets of papers and a great deal more content. Combined keeps most post-16 routes open and costs far less time. Schools push in different directions on this, and the right answer depends on the particular student rather than on ambition.

Additional Mathematics 0606 generates more tutoring requests around here than any other option, usually in the second term of Grade 10. It sits above the standard syllabus, brings in calculus and trigonometric identities early, and genuinely helps students heading for Mathematics at Higher Level or A Level. Students who took it because it sounded impressive tend to stall by the third topic.

Global Perspectives 0457 surprises people. It is a research and argumentation course with a team element, and a weak writer will find it harder than a science. Languages divide the same way. French 0520 rewards short daily contact far more than one weekly hour, while Hindi 0549 usually needs writing practice rather than vocabulary drilling. Art and Design 0400 runs entirely on portfolio deadlines the school sets.
items: Triple science against Combined Science 0654
Additional Mathematics 0606 as the most requested extra
Global Perspectives 0457 as a writing course in disguise
French 0520 needing frequency, Hindi 0549 needing writing
Art and Design 0400 governed by school portfolio dates

contentBlocks.heading: Cambridge IGCSE, Edexcel and what comes after Grade 10 in Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
IGCSE ends at Grade 10, and the question sitting underneath most tutoring enquiries from Sector 111 is really about what happens next.

Three routes are common among families here. The IB Diploma Programme, offered at several schools in the region, which expects a particular spread of subjects and reads IGCSE results as an indicator of readiness for Higher Level work. A Levels, which narrow to three or four subjects and care intensely about the grade in exactly those subjects. Or a move into an Indian board for Class 11 and 12, usually where a student is planning engineering or medical entrance preparation, and that transition is real work because the assessment style is not similar.

So not every IGCSE grade carries equal weight. A student heading for Mathematics at Higher Level needs the Extended or Higher tier paper and, ideally, Additional Mathematics behind them. A student heading into humanities does not, and pushing them through 0606 out of anxiety spends hours that English or Economics would have used far better.

Board choice matters less than subject choice at this stage. Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel qualifications are both accepted by the schools offering post-16 courses in and around the city, and neither closes a door on its own.
items: IB Diploma, A Levels or an Indian board as the usual next steps
Higher Level maths readiness judged on the Extended paper
Additional Mathematics valuable for some routes, wasted on others
Entrance-exam plans making the Class 11 switch harder
Subject choice mattering more than Cambridge against Edexcel

contentBlocks.heading: Sector 111 between Sector 110, Sector 112 and Sector 113
contentBlocks.body:
Sector 111 sits well along the Dwarka Expressway sectors, with Sector 110 and Sector 109 behind it towards central Gurugram, and Sector 112 and Sector 113 ahead towards the Delhi boundary. That position carries one practical advantage worth using. Tutors living in Dwarka or the western Delhi colonies are often closer to Sector 111 than tutors based on Golf Course Road, and for a seven o'clock slot that difference decides whether the session begins on time or twenty-five minutes late.

Sobha City, Puri Diplomatic Greens, ATS Triumph and ATS Kocoon are the residential addresses generating most enquiries along this stretch. A tutor already holding two families in the same tower will usually take a third without complaint, since the marginal travel cost is nothing. Enquiries also arrive from Palam Vihar and the New Gurgaon sectors, close enough to share the same pool of tutors.

The drawback deserves stating plainly. This is not a part of the city with an established walk-in tuition market, so the local choice for an uncommon subject is narrower than it would be in an older sector. Waiting for a nearby home tutor in a thin subject can cost a whole term, and an online specialist who can start next week is usually the better trade.
items: Sector 110, 112 and 113 as the immediate corridor
Dwarka-based tutors often closer than Golf Course Road ones
Third family in the same tower costing a tutor nothing extra
Palam Vihar and New Gurgaon sharing the same tutor pool
Thin local supply for uncommon subjects, online as the fix

contentBlocks.heading: Travel, timing and the case for online tutoring in Sector 111 Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
Work backwards from the clock. School ends, the bus takes its time, the child eats something, and what remains is roughly two usable hours before homework starts competing with sleep. Every tutoring decision in these sectors has to fit inside that window.

Home tutoring spends part of it on the tutor's travel risk. Somebody coming from Dwarka reaches Sector 111 reliably. Somebody crossing from Sohna Road at seven in the evening does not, and a session that starts twenty minutes late twice a week has lost a full session by month end.

Online carries a scheduling advantage that goes past travel. Sessions can be shorter and more frequent, which suits languages and mathematics considerably better than one long weekly block. A thirty-minute check the evening before a class test is straightforward online and impractical in person. During school trips or exam weeks, sessions can be moved or shortened without anybody driving anywhere.

Against that, a Grade 9 student who has not yet learned to sit still generally needs a person in the room, at least until the working habits exist. Many families here begin in person and move partly online during Grade 10, once the student runs their own revision and the tutor's job has narrowed to checking and correcting it.
items: Two usable hours after the bus, food and settling
Late arrivals compounding into a lost session each month
Short frequent online sessions suiting languages and maths
Sessions movable during trips and exam weeks
In person for Grade 9 habits, more online by Grade 10

contentBlocks.heading: Named schools near Sector 111, and our independent position
contentBlocks.body:
Families in Sector 111 typically send children to Scottish High International School, Lancers International School, Pathways World School or GD Goenka World School. IB Gram is an independent tutoring platform, is not officially affiliated with these schools, does not represent them, and does not exchange student records with them.

Worth saying plainly: these are well-resourced schools with subject specialists on staff, and a tutor is no substitute for attending class properly and using the teacher who is already paid to help. Where tutoring genuinely adds something is in the space a classroom cannot cover. A teacher with twenty-two students cannot sit beside one child and go through an entire script question by question, week after week. A tutor can, and that particular work is what changes a Grade 9 report.

The second useful function is calendar management. Each of these schools sets its own coursework windows, internal assessments and mock series, and the dates differ. A tutor who asks for the school calendar during the first week can put revision where it is needed rather than where the syllabus order suggests. If the school uses a particular textbook or a departmental question bank, hand that across as well. Working from material the child already owns beats introducing a fifth resource.

Independent platform, no affiliation and no shared records
Script-by-script review as the thing a classroom cannot do
School calendar collected in week one
School textbook and question bank used before any new resource

contentBlocks.heading: How tutors are screened before you meet them
contentBlocks.body:
Screening is a sequence of narrow questions with answers that can be checked.

Who is this person, confirmed against government identity documents. What did they study, confirmed against the certificate rather than the claim on a profile. Which boards and which papers have they taught, taken subject by subject, since a tutor may be strong on Cambridge Physics and have never opened an Edexcel paper. How long have they taught at this level, and where. References are requested where earlier teaching exists.

A subject discussion follows, and this is where most weak applications end. The tutor is asked how they would introduce a topic to a student who has already failed to understand it twice, and how they would mark a specific long-answer response against a real scheme. Vague answers are easy to recognise.

The things watched afterwards are simpler and matter just as much. Punctuality. Whether work set actually gets set. Whether a message about a doubt between sessions gets answered. Parent feedback is taken seriously and does affect whether a tutor keeps being recommended near Sector 111. If someone stops arriving on time, that is information worth having, not an inconvenience to be managed quietly on your side.
items: Government identity documents and original certificates
Board-by-board teaching history, not a general subject claim
A live marking question as the hardest filter
References sought where prior teaching exists
Punctuality and follow-up tracked after matching

contentBlocks.heading: What tutoring in Sector 111 Gurugram cannot do
contentBlocks.body:
A few things sit outside what any tutor can offer, and hearing them now saves disappointment later.

No grade is guaranteed. Not a 9, not a 7, not a percentage improvement on the last report. Anyone offering a guarantee is either misunderstanding how the marking works or counting on you not checking afterwards.

Motivation cannot be outsourced. A tutor can make a subject clearer, make progress visible, and restore a student's belief that the work is doable. A tutor cannot make a fifteen-year-old care about Business Studies if nothing else in the week supports it, and hiring a second tutor will not achieve it either.

Over-tutoring is a genuine risk in these sectors, where families can afford it and the schools are demanding. A student with four tutors has no hours left for unsupervised practice, and unsupervised practice is where most of the actual learning happens. Two well-chosen subjects usually beat four.

Cost is real and should be treated as such. Fees depend on subject, level, mode and session length, are stated before anything begins, and are worth reviewing after a term against what has changed. If nothing has changed, stop or switch rather than continuing out of habit.
items: No guaranteed grade, score or percentage improvement
Motivation as something tutoring supports, never supplies
Four tutors leaving no time for solo practice
Fees stated up front by subject, level, mode and length
A term-end review, with stopping as a legitimate outcome

contentBlocks.heading: Getting started with IGCSE tutors in Sector 111 Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
Start with the brief rather than the search. Write down the board, the subject codes if you have them, the school, the grade, the specific difficulty and the hours that genuinely exist in the week. That takes five minutes and saves a fortnight of circling.

An advisor uses it to check which tutors are actually free near Sector 111, along the Sector 110 to Sector 113 stretch, and across the wider Dwarka Expressway sectors. Availability is confirmed with each tutor first. A short list comes back to you rather than a single name, and you speak to each of them before deciding anything.

If your child is in Grade 9, say so, and ask the tutor to spend the first month on working habits and syllabus reading alongside the content itself. If your child is deep into Grade 10 with a series approaching, say that instead, and expect a plan concentrating on the marks that remain reachable in the time left. Both are legitimate briefs. They produce very different first sessions, and the tutor should know which one they are walking into.

Availability checked across Sector 110 to Sector 113
A short list to compare, not a single recommendation
Grade 9 habit-building and Grade 10 triage as different briefs

faqs.question: When should a Sector 111 family start tutoring, Grade 8 or Grade 9?
faqs.answer: Grade 8 support makes sense in one specific case: the child is about to choose options and is unsure whether they can handle triple science or Additional Mathematics later. A few sessions then can prevent a two-year mistake. Otherwise Grade 9 is the sensible starting point, because the course is running and there is real work to diagnose. Starting earlier than that tends to produce sessions with nothing concrete to fix, which wastes money and bores the student out of cooperating later when it matters.

faqs.question: Is Additional Mathematics 0606 worth taking?
faqs.answer: It is worth taking if the student is comfortable on the Extended or Higher tier paper and is likely to continue with mathematics or physics after Grade 10. It introduces calculus, functions and trigonometric identities that make the first term of a post-16 course much less brutal. It is not worth taking as an extra line on a transcript. Students who add it while already struggling with the standard syllabus usually end up damaging both. Ask the school what proportion of the cohort takes it and how it is timetabled before committing.

faqs.question: Our son is moving from CBSE into Grade 9 IGCSE. What is hardest about that?
faqs.answer: Written explanation, almost always. A student arriving from an Indian board is often stronger in mathematics computation than his new classmates and considerably weaker at answering a six-mark question that asks him to explain, evaluate or justify. The second difficulty is independence: nobody will chase a missing assignment in the same way. The content gap is usually the smallest of the three problems and closes fastest. Plan the first two months around writing and organisation rather than around covering topics, however counterintuitive that feels.

faqs.question: Do you share progress reports with my child's school?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is independent of Scottish High International School, Lancers International School, Pathways World School, GD Goenka World School and every other institution named here, and student information is not passed to them. What the tutor observes goes to you. You are free to share any of it with a class teacher or coordinator, and doing so is often useful before a parent-teacher meeting, but that decision stays with the family rather than being made on your behalf.

faqs.question: How many subjects should we arrange tutoring for at once?
faqs.answer: One or two, in most cases. Each subject adds hours that come out of the student's own practice time, and beyond two the schedule usually collapses into attending sessions instead of working. Pick the subject where marks are being lost most consistently, run it for a term, and reassess. If three subjects genuinely need help simultaneously, the underlying issue is often load or organisation rather than three separate content gaps, and that is a different conversation with the school rather than a bigger tutoring bill.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with coursework without doing it for the student?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the boundary needs to be explicit from the first session. A tutor can explain the assessment criteria, look at a plan, point out where an argument is unsupported, and teach the writing skill the task requires. A tutor must not write, dictate or heavily rewrite submitted work. Schools take authenticity seriously and the student signs a declaration. Any tutor who offers to produce coursework is putting your child at risk of a malpractice case, and that is a reason to end the arrangement immediately.

faqs.question: What if we live in Sector 112 or Sector 113 rather than Sector 111?
faqs.answer: Practically no difference. Tutors covering this corridor generally treat Sector 109 through Sector 113 as one area, since the travel between them is minutes. Give the exact society and sector when you enquire so home-visit timing can be assessed properly, because approach roads and gate procedures differ more than distance suggests. Families in Palam Vihar and the New Gurgaon sectors draw on much the same pool, so the shortlist tends to look similar. Availability still depends on the individual tutor's week.

faqs.question: Are weekend sessions possible, and are they better than weekday ones?
faqs.answer: Weekend sessions can usually be arranged and are the better slot for anything long: a full timed paper, a coursework planning session, or catching up an entire topic. Weekday evenings suit shorter, more frequent work, particularly language practice and doubt-solving before a class test. Many families around Sector 111 run one of each. Weekend availability is the first thing to fill up in the months before a series, so ask early rather than in March when everyone else has the same idea.

faqs.question: Does the tutor follow the school's textbook or the syllabus?
faqs.answer: The syllabus, with the school's textbook as the working material. The published Cambridge or Edexcel syllabus defines what can be examined and how it is assessed, and a tutor who ignores it will teach content the paper never asks for while missing something it always does. The school textbook still matters, because that is what the class is using and what the homework comes from. Bringing both together, plus past papers and mark schemes, is the arrangement that avoids confusing a student with a fifth version of everything.

contentBlocks.heading: Exam-season rescue work versus a two-year plan in Sector 112 Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
Most enquiries from Sector 112 arrive in a narrow window: late December, once the Grade 10 mock scripts come back and the marks are lower than anyone at home expected. Six or seven weeks of hard work follows, and it does help. It helps considerably less than the same hours would have done spread across Grade 9.

IGCSE is a two-year course examined once, externally, by Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel. Nothing your child did in Grade 9 appears on the certificate directly, yet almost everything on the final paper assumes it. Algebraic fluency. The ability to read a mark scheme and see why four marks were offered and only two given. Those are habits, and habits take months to build.

So the honest version is this. Tutoring booked in Grade 9 buys correction time, because a topic misunderstood in October can be rebuilt in November at no cost to anything else. Tutoring booked eight weeks before the June series buys triage. A tutor picks the topics with the highest mark yield, drills past papers, and quietly accepts that some ground is not recoverable in the time left.

Both are legitimate purchases. Families near Sobha City and Puri Diplomatic Greens book both, in different years, for different children. What matters is knowing which one you are buying before you agree to a schedule and a fee.
items: Grade 9 start: repair topics with no deadline pressure
January of Grade 10: triage by mark yield
Mock feedback is the usual trigger for a first call
Externally marked once, by Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel
Past-paper habit takes months, not weeks

contentBlocks.heading: Which IGCSE papers Sector 112 students most often ask about
contentBlocks.body:
Mathematics is the single most requested subject, and the first question is always which syllabus. Cambridge 0580 splits into Core and Extended, and a student entered for Core cannot be awarded above a C however well the paper goes. Some students along this corridor are on 0607 International Mathematics instead, where a graphics calculator is assumed and one paper is an investigation rather than a set of standard questions. Pearson Edexcel families are usually on 4MA1 Mathematics A, Foundation or Higher tier, two written papers of equal weight.

Physics and Chemistry come next. Cambridge 0625 and 0620 both carry a practical component, and most schools enter students for the alternative to practical paper rather than the live practical test. That paper rewards a very particular skill: describing an experiment you did not personally perform, spotting the control variable, reading a graph drawn badly under time pressure. Edexcel 4PH1 and 4CH1 fold practical reasoning into the theory papers instead, which changes how revision should be structured.

English is the quiet problem. Cambridge 0500 First Language English asks for directed writing and a summary under a tight clock, and strong readers still bleed marks because they answer the question they wanted rather than the one printed on the page.

Economics and Business Studies requests rise sharply in Grade 10, usually after the first data-response assessment goes badly.
items: 0580 Core is graded C to G; check the entry decision early
0607 International Mathematics assumes a graphics calculator
Alternative to practical is a trainable paper of its own
4MA1 Higher tier: two papers, equal weighting
0500 summary marks lost to over-writing, not to weak reading

contentBlocks.heading: Grade 9 groundwork and Grade 10 finishing are two different jobs
contentBlocks.body:
A tutor who is good with a Grade 9 is not automatically good with a Grade 10 in February, and the reverse holds just as often.

Grade 9 work is slow and unglamorous. The syllabus is being met for the first time, the school is still teaching new content weekly, and a tutor's job is largely to keep pace with the class while repairing whatever came out of Class 8 half-formed. Negative indices that never settled. The habit of reading a question stem twice before writing anything. Sessions can be shorter and less frequent here, and a fortnightly slot is often sufficient for a student who is broadly coping.

Grade 10 changes shape after the first mock. Content teaching finishes somewhere in the winter term, and everything after that is retrieval and timing. A tutor should be working from a stack of past papers and the published mark schemes rather than from textbook chapter order. Younger siblings in the same flat may be on a lower secondary programme with no external exam at all, where support looks nothing like this: reading stamina, written fluency, arithmetic confidence. Sector 112 parents often ask for both at once. One tutor rarely covers both well.

contentBlocks.heading: Home, online and split-week tutoring in Sector 112 Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
Sector 112 sits on the Dwarka Expressway side of the city, and that single fact governs everything about home tutoring here. A tutor living around Sohna Road or Sector 57 is looking at a long one-way trip, and they will either price that time in or decline the booking. Home tutoring inside Sobha City, Puri Diplomatic Greens, ATS Triumph and ATS Kocoon is most realistic when the tutor already lives on this side of the expressway or near Palam Vihar, or when two or three families in the same tower cluster anchor them here for an evening.

Online removes that problem and introduces a smaller one. For Grade 10 past-paper work it is close to equivalent, provided the student photographs and shares working before the session rather than fumbling with a phone camera during it. For a Grade 9 who has not yet learned to sit with a hard problem for ten minutes, a screen makes drifting easier.

The split week is what most families here settle on. One home session at the weekend for the subject that needs a person in the room, one or two online sessions midweek at nine in the evening, after dinner and after the school bag has been repacked.

Home availability is never guaranteed in this corridor and depends on tutor schedules that shift every term.
items: Travel from Golf Course Road or Sohna Road is priced in
Same-complex bookings make home sessions more likely
Online suits past-paper drilling; weaker for restless Grade 9s
Common pattern: weekend at home, weekday online at 9 pm
Availability reviewed per term, subject to tutor schedules

contentBlocks.heading: From your first message to a shortlist of names
contentBlocks.body:
The sequence is short and deliberately unglamorous.

One. You tell an advisor four things: the board, the exact subjects, the grade, and the two or three slots that are genuinely free in your week. Board matters more than parents expect, because a tutor fluent in Edexcel 4CH1 is not automatically fluent in the paper conventions of Cambridge 0620.

Two. We work out what the real problem is. A parent usually reports a subject. Underneath it there is often a narrower fault: the student understands the Chemistry but loses six marks a paper on moles arithmetic, or the Physics answers are correct and structured so poorly that the examiner cannot award the method mark. That distinction changes which tutor is right.

Three. We filter for people who have taught that specification recently and can work inside your window. Availability gets checked before names are shared, not afterwards.

Four. You receive a short list with what each tutor has taught, their format, and a fee band. Two or three names. Not twenty profiles to compare.

Five. The first session runs as a diagnostic. Expect the tutor to put a past-paper question in front of your child within the first twenty minutes, and to speak to you afterwards about what they saw.

If nothing on the list fits, say so and we look again.

Subject complaint gets narrowed to the actual fault
Availability confirmed before any name is sent
Two or three names with fee bands, not a directory

contentBlocks.heading: Sector 112 Gurugram and the Dwarka Expressway sectors beside it
contentBlocks.body:
Sector 112 has Sector 111 on one side and Sector 113 on the other, with Sector 110 a short drive further along the same corridor. Palam Vihar and the older Gurugram roads lie behind it. New Gurgaon and the higher sector numbers run ahead toward the Delhi boundary. The whole strip is high-rise, comparatively young, and built faster than the roads feeding it.

Two practical consequences for tutoring follow from that. Residential density here is vertical, so a tutor who takes one student in ATS Triumph can often take a second in the same complex without adding a minute of travel, and that sometimes softens the rate. The second consequence is less convenient. The walk-in tuition layer that older parts of Gurugram accumulated over decades barely exists on this stretch. Families here are choosing between a tutor who travels and a tutor on a screen, very rarely between two neighbourhood centres.

Traffic on the expressway is unpredictable at exactly the hours tutoring happens. A 6.30 pm start booked from across the city becomes a 6.55 pm start more often than anyone admits, and the lost half hour comes out of a session you paid for. Booking someone already based on this side of Gurugram matters more here than it does in most of the city.

Palam Vihar behind, New Gurgaon ahead toward Delhi

contentBlocks.heading: What is checked before a tutor's name reaches you
contentBlocks.body:
Verification here means a set of specific checks, not a badge on a profile.

Identity is confirmed against a government photo ID. Qualifications are checked against the degree and any teaching certification claimed, and we ask which institution and which years, because IGCSE experience quoted without dates usually turns out to mean one student, once, some time ago.

Board and specification experience gets checked at code level. Which syllabus have you taught. In which series. What did the cohort look like. A tutor who has carried 4MA1 Higher tier through three sittings is a different proposition from one who has read the specification carefully and taught something adjacent.

We ask for a sample of how they mark. A tutor who returns a past-paper script with a total written at the top and no annotation anywhere is not much use to a Grade 10 in February, whatever the degree says.

References are requested where a tutor has taught privately before, and we ask those families about reliability and communication rather than about grades, since grades depend on far more than the tutor.

None of this predicts whether your child will get on with the person. It rules out obvious mismatches and confirms what the profile claims. The first session is still where you learn whether your daughter will admit to this adult what she does not understand.

contentBlocks.heading: The Sector 112 Gurugram school run, and what it does to timetables
contentBlocks.body:
Students in this part of Gurugram travel out to school, and that travel is the real constraint on tutoring. Scottish High International School, Lancers International School, Pathways World School and GD Goenka World School all draw families from the Dwarka Expressway sectors, and none of them are next door. A bus that leaves before seven in the morning and returns at four or half past four does not leave a generous evening behind it.

IB Gram has no relationship with any of these schools. We are an independent tutoring platform, we receive no lists or referrals from them, and no tutor should ever be described to you as a particular school's tutor.

In practice this means the first weekday session rarely works before six in the evening, and Friday is usually a write-off for anything cognitively demanding. Saturday morning is the most productive slot most families on this stretch have, which is why it fills early in the academic year.

School assessment calendars matter as much as school timings. If your school runs its Grade 10 mock in late November rather than January, the entire revision plan shifts forward by six weeks and the tutor needs to know that on day one. Tell the advisor the mock date at the start. It is the single most useful piece of information a parent can supply.

contentBlocks.heading: Things we will not tell you about IGCSE results
contentBlocks.body:
A few sentences a tutoring platform is not supposed to write.

We cannot promise a grade. Nobody honestly can, and any service that puts a number in front of you before meeting your child is selling something other than teaching. Papers are marked externally against a published mark scheme, and grade boundaries move from series to series.

We will not quote success rates, pass percentages or star ratings, because we would be inventing them. There are no testimonials on this page for the same reason.

We will not pretend a late start carries no cost. A Grade 10 arriving in March with three subjects in trouble will improve, but the improvement has a ceiling, and a decent tutor tells you roughly where that ceiling sits instead of agreeing to five sessions a week and hoping.

What we will describe is process. What gets checked before a name is sent. What a first session actually looks like. What you should be able to observe after four weeks, which is either a past-paper score that has moved or a student who can now explain why marks were lost. If neither has happened by then, the match is wrong, and telling us early costs you far less than waiting until the entries close.

No invented pass rates, ratings or testimonials

Grade boundaries shift each series
Four-week check: moved score, or a student who can explain lost marks

There is no charge for the shortlist and no obligation once you have it. The first session runs as a diagnostic, which means your child will be given work rather than a welcome speech, and you should expect a short conversation afterwards about what the tutor saw.

faqs.question: How do I find out whether my child is on Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel?
faqs.answer: Look at the statement of entry, or at the syllabus code printed on the school booklist. Cambridge codes are four digits beginning with a zero: 0580 for Mathematics, 0625 Physics, 0620 Chemistry, 0500 First Language English. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE codes begin with a four, such as 4MA1, 4PH1, 4CH1 and 4EA1. Some schools serving this part of Gurugram run a mix across departments, which surprises parents. Give the advisor the code rather than the subject name, because paper structure, mark schemes and past-paper stock differ between the boards even where content overlaps.

faqs.question: Is it too late to start tutoring in Grade 10?
faqs.answer: Not too late, but be clear about what the remaining months can realistically do. A tutor starting in January before the June series works from past papers and grade-boundary arithmetic, targeting topics where marks are cheapest to recover. That often moves a grade, sometimes two in a subject where the gap was technique rather than content. It rarely rebuilds two years of unsteady algebra. If you are starting late, take fewer subjects and go deep on them rather than booking four and spreading the same hours thin across all of them.

faqs.question: What do IGCSE tuition fees around Sector 112 depend on?
faqs.answer: Board and level, subject, format, and travel. Higher tier Mathematics and the sciences at Extended level cost more than lower secondary support, simply because fewer people teach them well. Home sessions on the Dwarka Expressway side carry a travel component that online sessions do not. Sibling bookings or two students in the same complex sometimes bring the hourly rate down. Rates reach you as a band before you meet anybody, and nothing is payable for the shortlist itself. Ask about cancellation terms in the first conversation rather than discovering them later.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to Sobha City or ATS Triumph, or should we assume online?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on who is free in this corridor at the time you need. Sector 112 is far enough from Sohna Road and Golf Course Road that a tutor based there will either decline or price the journey in. Tutors already living near Palam Vihar, the Dwarka Expressway sectors or the northern side of Gurugram are far more likely to agree, particularly if they are already teaching another student in the same complex. Ask early in the term. Home availability is verified before names are sent, and it genuinely varies.

faqs.question: My son is entered for Cambridge 0580 Core. Can he move to Extended?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the decision belongs to the school rather than to a tutor. Core is graded C to G, so a student sitting Core cannot be awarded a B or above regardless of how the paper goes. If the plan afterwards involves A Level Mathematics or a higher level Diploma Programme course, that ceiling matters a great deal. Raise it with the school early in Grade 10, before entries close, and bring recent paper scores to the conversation. A tutor can build the Extended content in the months available, but only if the entry itself changes in time.

faqs.question: Do tutors help with the alternative to practical paper?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is worth requesting specifically rather than assuming it comes bundled. The Cambridge alternative to practical paper tests whether a student can reason about an experiment on paper: identifying variables, spotting sources of error, plotting and reading a graph under time pressure, describing a method precisely enough for someone else to repeat it. Students who are comfortable in the theory papers often lose a block of marks here because school laboratory time was limited. It responds well to training. Several years of past papers with proper feedback usually moves the score.

faqs.question: How many sessions a week does a Grade 10 actually need?
faqs.answer: Through Grade 9, one session a week per subject is usually plenty, and fortnightly works for a student who is coping. From January of Grade 10 the arithmetic changes. Weekly becomes the floor for any subject that is genuinely in trouble, and many families move to two sessions for Mathematics or a science through February and March. Beyond about three contact hours a week in one subject, returns fall away fast for a fifteen year old who is also sitting school mocks. Sleep and solo past-paper practice count for as much as contact hours.

faqs.question: What should we expect to see after four weeks?
faqs.answer: Something you can point at. A past-paper score that has moved, or a student who can look at a returned script and explain where the marks went and why. Those are different signals and either one counts. What you should not see is a child who reports that sessions are fine but cannot describe what was covered on Tuesday. Ask them to explain one topic to you at the end of the month. If they cannot, raise it with the tutor directly, and if nothing changes in a fortnight, ask for a different match.

faqs.question: Can one tutor take both Physics and Chemistry?
faqs.answer: Often yes, and it can be efficient, since the quantitative work in Cambridge 0620 and 0625 overlaps and one tutor keeps the calculation habits consistent across both. Check the depth carefully though. Somebody comfortable with both at Core level is not necessarily comfortable with both at Extended, and organic chemistry and electricity tend to be taught well by quite different kinds of teacher. Where one subject is far weaker than the other, two specialists usually beat one generalist, subject to tutor availability at the hours you can actually offer.

introSummary: IGCSE tutors in Sector 113 Gurugram work with Grade 9 and Grade 10 students on both Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel syllabuses, online across the city and at home in the Dwarka Expressway societies when a tutor's route allows. Start by identifying the board and the syllabus code, because past papers, tiers and exam series all differ between them. contentBlocks.heading: The Short Answer for Sector 113 Gurugram Parents
contentBlocks.body:
Short version: yes, tutors work with families here, mostly online across the city and at home in the societies along this stretch when a route allows it. Fees are quoted as a band before you meet anybody. Sessions usually begin within a week of the first call, subject to who is free at your hour.

Now the detail that decides whether the arrangement actually works.

The first thing to establish is not the tutor. It is the board. A child in Grade 9 here is sitting either Cambridge IGCSE or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, and the two are not interchangeable. Cambridge grades most subjects A* to G, with a 9 to 1 variant used by some schools. Edexcel International GCSE is graded 9 to 1 throughout. Cambridge runs June and November series, with a March series available in India. Edexcel offers a January window alongside the summer one, which matters a lot if a resit ever comes up.

Second thing to establish is the tier. Cambridge splits subjects into Core and Extended. Edexcel uses Foundation and Higher. That entry decision quietly caps the maximum grade before your child has written a single word in the exam hall.

Everything further down this page follows from those two facts.

contentBlocks.heading: Grade 9 to Grade 10, and the Year That Decides the Rest
contentBlocks.body:
IGCSE is normally a two-year course sat at the end of Grade 10, though some schools begin parts of the syllabus in Grade 8 and stretch it out. The subjects chosen at the start of Grade 9 are not a small administrative step. A student who takes Coordinated Sciences as a double award rather than three separate sciences, or who drops Additional Mathematics, has narrowed what Grade 11 can look like, whether that turns out to be A Levels or a Diploma Programme with a higher level science.

So the useful tutoring question in Grade 9 is not simply whether the child is coping. It is whether they are coping well enough in this particular subject to keep the door open.

Grade 10 is a different animal. The syllabus finishes, mocks arrive, and the work turns examiner-facing: command words, mark allocation, the discipline of producing four marks' worth of answer for a four-mark question instead of a paragraph that says everything known about the topic.

Below Grade 9, families along this corridor often want help with a lower secondary programme where no external exam exists yet. That work is about reading volume, writing at length, and arithmetic becoming automatic. It is genuinely different teaching, and worth booking as such rather than assuming an examined-syllabus specialist will enjoy it.

Double award versus three separate sciences: ask before entries close
Grade 10 work becomes examiner-facing after mocks

contentBlocks.heading: Where Sector 113 Sits on the Dwarka Expressway Corridor
contentBlocks.body:
Sector 113 sits alongside Sector 112 and Sector 111 on the expressway strip, with Palam Vihar and the older Gurugram roads on one side and New Gurgaon running out toward the Delhi boundary on the other. Addresses here are ambiguous in a way that turns out to matter. A family in Sobha City or Puri Diplomatic Greens may describe themselves as Sector 112 or Sector 113 depending on which gate they use, and residents of ATS Triumph and ATS Kocoon do much the same. A tutor's nearest-student calculation is therefore not really a sector calculation. It is a question of which gate, which service road, and what the expressway is doing at that hour.

Something else about this stretch deserves saying plainly. A large share of households here moved in recently, and some moved mid-academic-year. There is not much of a settled parent network to ask, so families search online rather than collecting a name from a neighbour who has used somebody for three years. That absence is exactly why a page like this exists.

The practical upside is real. A tutor already teaching in one tower here will often take a second student in another, because walking between two gates costs them nothing at all.

contentBlocks.heading: Subject by Subject, With the Syllabus Codes Attached
contentBlocks.body:
Mathematics requests dominate here as everywhere, but the shape of the request differs by board. Edexcel 4MA1 sets two written papers of equal length and no coursework. Cambridge 0580 separates Core from Extended. Students on 0607 International Mathematics meet an investigation paper that rewards a way of working most tuition never touches, so ask specifically whether a prospective tutor has taught it.

English divides more sharply than parents expect. Cambridge 0500 First Language English assumes a student reads comfortably and writes at speed under a clock. Cambridge 0510 and 0511 English as a Second Language are a separate qualification with different expectations, and a child placed in the wrong one is either bored or quietly drowning. Edexcel 4EA1 English Language A allows a coursework route in place of one written paper at some schools, which reshapes the revision calendar entirely.

Sciences run as Cambridge 0610 Biology, 0620 Chemistry and 0625 Physics taken separately, or 0654 Coordinated Sciences as a double award covering all three in less depth. The Edexcel equivalents are 4BI1, 4CH1 and 4PH1.

Economics 0455, Business Studies 0450 and Computer Science 0478 appear less often. Specialists for them are scarcer across Gurugram and their evening slots go early in the year.

contentBlocks.heading: IGCSE Schools Sector 113 Gurugram Families Send Children To
contentBlocks.body:
Children from this part of Gurugram attend Scottish High International School, Lancers International School, Pathways World School and GD Goenka World School among others, and every one of those involves a proper commute rather than a walk to the gate.

IB Gram is an independent tutoring platform with no affiliation to any of these schools. We are given no student lists, we are endorsed by none of them, and no tutor is ever presented to you as being attached to a particular school.

Two consequences follow from the school mix on this corridor. Schools set their own internal calendars, so two children living in the same tower can have mocks six weeks apart and need completely different revision plans in January. One tutor working with both cannot run a single schedule for them.

The second consequence is more particular to Sector 113. Because so many families here arrived recently, mid-programme school changes are common, and a move between a Cambridge school and an Edexcel school during Grade 10 is not a minor adjustment. Content largely overlaps. Paper conventions and coursework requirements do not. If your child has changed schools since Grade 9 began, mention it in the first conversation, because it usually changes which tutor makes sense and how the first month is spent.

contentBlocks.heading: How a Sector 113 Gurugram Enquiry Becomes Two or Three Names
contentBlocks.body:
An advisor asks a small number of questions. The reasons behind them are not obvious, so here they are.

Which board and which syllabus code. This determines the past-paper stock a tutor works from and whether their marking instincts match the examiner your child will actually face.

What the last two assessments looked like, and can you photograph a marked script. A script tells us more in thirty seconds than a parent's summary manages in ten minutes. It shows whether marks are being lost to missing content, to weak method, or to running out of time on the last question.

Which evenings are real. Not which evenings are theoretically free. A slot that collides with football on alternate weeks collapses by the third session and nobody says why.

Home, online, or either. This answer changes the size of the available pool considerably in this part of the city.

From there we filter for tutors who have taught that specification recently, confirm they can work at your hour, and send two or three names with fee bands and a note on what each has actually taught. The first session runs as a diagnostic and the tutor should speak to you afterwards. If none of the names feel right, say so and the search runs again.
items: Syllabus code first, subject name second
A photographed marked script beats a verbal summary
Only genuinely protected evenings get used for matching
Format preference changes the size of the pool
Two or three names, then a diagnostic session

contentBlocks.heading: Home Tuition and Online Lessons in Sector 113: the Real Trade-off
contentBlocks.body:
Online tutoring is better than its reputation, for one specific reason. The pool of people who can teach Edexcel 4CH1 at Higher tier, or the 0607 investigation paper, is small in any single city, and restricting the search to those who can drive to your gate at seven on a Tuesday shrinks it further. For a rare subject or an unusual paper, a screen is often the difference between a specialist and whoever happens to be nearby.

Home tutoring earns its place elsewhere. A younger student who needs somebody to notice they have stopped writing. A teenager who will not admit confusion to a face on a screen but will mutter it across a table. Handwritten working that has to be watched as it forms rather than reviewed after.

Two honest drawbacks of home sessions in a high-rise on this corridor. Guest entry and lift time eat into the hour more than anyone plans for. And a session at the dining table with a television running in the next room is usually worse than the same session held online in a quiet bedroom.

Hybrid tends to win. Home where presence matters, online for drilling and doubt-solving. Home availability for your address can be reviewed, subject to tutor schedules that shift each term.
items: Rare specifications: online widens the pool sharply
Home suits younger students and reluctant talkers
Guest entry and lift time cut into paid minutes
A quiet room online beats a busy dining table
Hybrid split: presence at home, drilling online

contentBlocks.heading: The Claims This Page Deliberately Avoids Making
contentBlocks.body:
You will not find a figure on this page for how many tutors are on the platform. That number would be unverifiable by you and would tell you nothing useful, since what matters is whether one suitable person is free at your hour on a Wednesday in February.

There are no ratings out of five, no success percentages, and no parent quotes. Anything of that sort here would be manufactured, and a family choosing a tutor for a Grade 10 deserves better than manufactured evidence.

The word best is also avoided. Best for a student who reads widely and freezes under a clock is a completely different person from best for a student who never opens a book but calculates quickly and carelessly.

What can be stated honestly: the checks a tutor passes before their name is sent to you, the fact that IB Gram is independent of every school mentioned here, and the fact that a mismatch can be raised at any point and a different name found without a fight about it. Grades belong to the examiner, to the student, and to two years of school teaching. A tutor shifts the odds. Nobody is in a position to sell you the outcome.
items: No tutor headcount claimed
No ratings, pass rates or parent quotes
No single best tutor, because the fit depends on the student
Independent of every school named
Mismatches get changed, not defended

contentBlocks.heading: Tutor Checks, Listed Plainly
contentBlocks.body:
Identity is confirmed against government photo identification before a profile goes anywhere near a parent.

Academic record covers the degree claimed, the institution, and the years attended. Where a teaching qualification is claimed, that is checked as well.

Specification history is the check that most often changes our view of a profile. Which board, which syllabus code, which series, and how many cohorts. Plenty of capable graduates have never taught an examined syllabus and genuinely do not know what a mark scheme rewards, which is a different thing from not knowing the subject.

Teaching evidence means a worked example of how the tutor explains a topic, and where possible a marked script showing the annotation a student would actually receive back.

Communication gets watched during the enquiry itself. Whether somebody replies clearly and on time before they have been paid is a small signal and a reliable one.

What is not checked deserves stating. Personality fit is not tested. We do not observe a tutor teaching your child before you do. We cannot audit every claim about a school somebody once worked at. The diagnostic first session exists partly to cover that gap, which is why you should ask for the tutor's read on your child straight afterwards rather than waiting a month.
items: Government photo ID confirmed first
Degree, institution, years, plus any teaching qualification
Board and syllabus code history, by series and cohort
Worked explanation and, where possible, a marked script
Fit and classroom manner are not verifiable in advance

contentBlocks.heading: Booking IGCSE Tuition in Sector 113 Gurugram
contentBlocks.body:
Three pieces of information get you a useful answer quickly. The syllabus code for each subject. A photograph of the most recent marked assessment. The hours in your week that are honestly free.

An advisor comes back with a small number of tutors who have taught that exact specification, with fee bands, format, and a straight answer on whether anybody can currently reach your gate at the time you need. If home tutoring is not workable this term for your address, you will be told that rather than strung along for a fortnight.

Nothing is charged for the shortlist. The first session runs as a diagnostic, which means your child works through real questions and the tutor tells you afterwards what they saw, including the parts you would rather not hear.

Then watch for four weeks. A moved past-paper score is good. A student who can explain their own errors without prompting is better. If neither appears, come back and the match gets changed rather than defended.

One timing note. Home slots on this corridor are easiest to arrange early in a term and hardest to find in the weeks immediately before the summer series.
items: Bring the syllabus code, a marked script, and real free hours
Shortlist carries fee band, format and reach
A no on home tutoring is said plainly
Diagnostic first session, honest debrief
Book early in the term, not weeks before the papers

faqs.question: Cambridge or Edexcel: does the board change which tutor we need?
faqs.answer: It changes the past papers, the mark schemes and often the paper structure, so yes. Both boards cover similar content at Grade 9 and Grade 10 but examine it differently, and even the tier names differ: Core and Extended for Cambridge, Foundation and Higher for Edexcel. A tutor who has taught only one board can usually learn the other, though not in the eight weeks before a series. Give the advisor the syllabus code from the school booklist, and the shortlist is filtered on that rather than on the subject name alone.

faqs.question: When are the IGCSE exam sessions, and does that change when we should start?
faqs.answer: Cambridge runs June and November series, with a March series available in India, so a school here may enter students in more than one window. Pearson Edexcel offers a January series alongside the summer one, which is the usual route for a resit. Confirm with your school which series it enters, because the entire revision plan hangs off that date. Working backwards, serious past-paper practice usually needs to begin around five months before the first paper, and any content repair has to happen before that starts.

faqs.question: We moved to Sector 113 mid-year and my daughter changed schools. Where do we start?
faqs.answer: Say so in the first conversation, because it changes the plan. A move between a Cambridge school and an Edexcel school mid-course means content largely transfers while paper conventions, coursework requirements and the internal assessment calendar do not. The first month with a tutor is better spent mapping what has already been covered against the new specification, subject by subject, than on general revision. This happens often along the Dwarka Expressway sectors, where many households arrived recently, so it is a familiar request rather than an odd one.

faqs.question: Is Coordinated Sciences a problem if she wants Physics in Grade 11?
faqs.answer: Not automatically, but check rather than assume. Cambridge 0654 Coordinated Sciences is a double award covering biology, chemistry and physics in less depth than the three separate syllabuses. Some Grade 11 courses accept it for a science pathway and some prefer the separate subject behind it. If a higher level or A Level science is the plan, ask the school directly what they expect, and ask early enough that a subject change is still administratively possible. A tutor can support either route, but that entry decision belongs to the school.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with the Edexcel English Language A coursework option?
faqs.answer: Where a school offers the coursework route in place of a written paper, a tutor can support the process without writing any part of it. That means helping the student pick tasks that suit their strengths, planning structure, reading drafts against the published assessment criteria, and being blunt about what a piece is currently worth. What a tutor must never do is draft or rewrite the work, because authenticity requirements sit with the school and the board. Confirm with your school which route your child is actually on.

faqs.question: How much notice do you need before sessions can start?
faqs.answer: Usually a few days, occasionally the same week, and sometimes longer for a rare subject at Higher or Extended level. The limiting factor is almost never assembling the shortlist. It is finding somebody genuinely free at the hour you want, and evening slots between six and nine fill first right across Gurugram. If your timing is fixed and narrow, expect fewer names to come back. If a weekend morning can also be offered, the pool widens noticeably and the match tends to be a better one.

faqs.question: Do tutors teach in small groups, and does that cost less?
faqs.answer: Small groups exist and they do cost less per student, but the fit is narrow. Two students on the same board, at the same tier and roughly the same standing can work well together, particularly for past-paper sessions where talking through an answer helps both. It goes wrong quickly when one of them is two topics behind, because the pace ends up set by whoever speaks most. For a subject that is genuinely failing, individual sessions are the honest recommendation even at the higher rate.

faqs.question: My son says he understands everything but scores badly in tests. What is happening?
faqs.answer: Usually one of three things, and a marked script will show which one. He may be answering a different question from the one printed, which is a command-word problem rather than a knowledge problem. He may know the material and be unable to retrieve it at speed under a clock. Or he may follow explanations given by someone else while being unable to generate the steps alone, which feels like understanding from the inside. Each has a different fix, and none of them is simply more hours.

faqs.question: What happens if we need to pause for holidays or family travel?
faqs.answer: Pausing is normal and should be agreed with the tutor rather than left vague. Plenty of families here travel over the winter break and again in summer, and a two or three week gap early in Grade 9 costs very little. The same gap in February of Grade 10 costs a great deal. Where travel close to the papers is unavoidable, a shorter online session from wherever you are usually beats stopping altogether. Settle notice periods and rescheduling terms in the first week rather than improvising them later.

introSummary: IGCSE tutors in Sector 14 Gurugram support Grade 9 and Grade 10 students on Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel syllabuses, at home across the older HUDA sectors and the Palam Vihar side of the city, or online. The work at this stage is mostly about exam habits: reading command words, showing working, writing to the marks available, and finishing the paper on time. IB Gram is an independent platform that matches on syllabus code and confirmed teaching history rather than on proximity alone.

contentBlocks.heading: The habits IGCSE rewards, and where Grade 9 students lose them
contentBlocks.body:
There is a particular moment in Grade 9 when a competent student starts losing marks and nobody at home can explain why. The work looks right. The answers are broadly correct. The score comes back a grade below what everyone expected.

What has changed is the marker. School tests up to Class 8 tend to reward a correct final answer and visible effort. An IGCSE paper is marked by somebody who has never met your child, working from a published mark scheme, awarding marks for specified steps and specified words. A Physics answer saying the ball speeds up earns nothing where the scheme wanted an increase in kinetic energy. A Mathematics answer with the right number and no working loses the method marks entirely.

The habits that matter at this stage are narrow and teachable. Reading the command word and doing exactly what it asks: state, describe, explain, calculate, suggest. Writing enough for the marks on offer and then stopping. Showing every line of working even when the arithmetic feels obvious. Practising against a clock, because a paper is an exercise in rationing time as much as in knowing content.

Which is why the tutor worth having is not simply somebody who knows the subject. It is somebody who has marked against these schemes and can show a student, line by line, where a correct thought failed to earn its mark.
items: Command words: state, describe, explain, calculate, suggest
Marks awarded for specified steps, not for effort
Working shown even when the answer is obvious
Length matched to the marks, then stop
Timed practice as a separate skill from knowing content

contentBlocks.heading: Sector 14 Gurugram, Palam Vihar and the older sectors around it
contentBlocks.body:
Sector 14 belongs to the older, planned part of Gurugram: plotted low-rise housing and HUDA sector layouts rather than gated towers, with Sector 15 next door, Palam Vihar a short drive across, and Udyog Vihar and the working roads toward the Delhi boundary beyond that. Compared with the newer sectors out along the Dwarka Expressway, everything sits closer together and stays easier to reach after dark.

That geography helps home tutoring considerably. A tutor living in Palam Vihar or one of the neighbouring older sectors can take an evening student here without surrendering forty minutes to a highway, which widens the pool of people willing to come to your door on a weekday.

There is a catch worth knowing before you walk down the road to the nearest tuition board. The established tuition market in this part of Gurugram grew up around Indian board syllabuses, because that is what most students living here sit. A well-regarded Class 10 mathematics teacher two streets away may be genuinely good and still be the wrong choice for Cambridge 0580 Extended, where notation, question phrasing and mark scheme conventions all differ. Proximity is useful here in a way it is not elsewhere in the city. It is not, by itself, a qualification.
items: Plotted HUDA housing, not high-rise; short local distances
Sector 15 adjacent, Palam Vihar and Udyog Vihar close by
Wider home-tutor pool than the far expressway sectors
Local tuition market is board-syllabus oriented
Ask any nearby teacher which examined syllabus they have taught

contentBlocks.heading: Choosing between a tutor at your door and a tutor on a screen
contentBlocks.body:
Home tutoring is more realistic here than in most of Gurugram, so the question is not whether it can be arranged. It is whether it is the better choice for this student and this subject.

A tutor in the room wins where attention is the problem. A Grade 9 who reads a question, writes two lines, then drifts needs somebody who notices within seconds rather than at the end of the hour. It also suits handwriting-heavy work, since a tutor watching a page fill up catches a bad habit as it forms instead of correcting it a week later.

Online wins where expertise is the problem. If your child is on Edexcel 4CH1 at Higher tier, or needs the 0607 investigation paper, the person who has genuinely taught that specification may live in another city altogether. Refusing a specialist because they cannot drive to your gate on a Tuesday is a poor trade in Grade 10.

There is a third arrangement families here use more than they admit to. One subject at home, another online, in the same week. It costs nothing extra and puts each subject with the format that actually suits it.

Home sessions stay subject to tutor availability, and reach can be reviewed for your specific address before you commit.
items: In-person for attention, handwriting and younger students
Online for rare specifications and higher tiers
Mixed week: one subject at home, one on screen
Specialist beats nearby for a Grade 10 problem subject
Reach checked for your address, subject to availability

contentBlocks.heading: Subject-level detail for Sector 14 Gurugram students
contentBlocks.body:
Applying those habits subject by subject makes the tutoring brief far sharper than a request for help with science.

Mathematics, Cambridge 0580 or Edexcel 4MA1. Marks disappear in three predictable places: working omitted on multi-step questions, rounding done too early in a calculation, and the wordy questions late in the paper where the mathematics is easy and the reading is not. A tutor should be looking at your child's script for those patterns before choosing any topic list.

Physics 0625 and 4PH1. Units, and the gap between describing and explaining. Students who calculate confidently still surrender whole questions by answering a six-mark explanation in a single line.

Chemistry 0620 and 4CH1. Moles arithmetic and the organic naming sequences account for most of the lost marks, and both respond quickly to steady drilling.

Biology 0610 and 4BI1 punishes vague vocabulary harder than any other science. Diffusion and osmosis are not interchangeable words to a marker.

English 0500 or 4EA1. Timing above all else. Able students routinely produce one fine answer and one unfinished one.

Economics 0455 and Business Studies 0450 need the case-study extract used directly, with figures quoted, rather than paraphrased from memory.
items: 0580 and 4MA1: early rounding and skipped working
0625 and 4PH1: units, plus describe versus explain
0620 and 4CH1: moles arithmetic, organic naming
0610 and 4BI1: precise biological vocabulary
0455 and 0450: quote the extract, do not paraphrase it

contentBlocks.heading: What an advisor asks before suggesting anybody
contentBlocks.body:
A vague brief produces a vague shortlist, so here is what a strong one contains and what a weak one leaves out.

Weak: my son is in Grade 10 and needs help with Maths.

Stronger: Grade 10, Cambridge 0580 Extended, scoring in the mid fifties in school tests, losing most marks on trigonometry and on the long word problems, school mock in early January, free Tuesday and Thursday after 6.30 pm, home preferred in Sector 14 but online acceptable for one of the two sessions.

The second version can be matched the same day. The first needs three phone calls before it becomes usable, and those calls happen during the week you wanted the sessions to start.

What happens next: we filter for tutors who have taught that syllabus recently, confirm they are genuinely free at those hours rather than nominally free, and send two or three names with what each has taught, their format, and a fee band. Availability is verified before a name reaches you, so you are not chasing people who cannot take the slot.

The first session is a diagnostic. Afterwards, ask the tutor for one sentence on what is actually wrong. If they cannot produce it, that is information too.
items: Grade, board, syllabus code, tier
Where marks are being lost, not just which subject
School mock date and the protected weekday slots
Format preference, including a fallback
One-sentence diagnosis requested after the first session

contentBlocks.heading: Lower secondary, Grade 9, Grade 10, and what comes after
contentBlocks.body:
The habits described at the top of this page do not appear from nowhere at fourteen, and they do not stop mattering at sixteen.

Below Grade 9, in a lower secondary programme, the useful work is unglamorous. Reading books longer than a chapter. Writing more than four sentences without stopping. Getting number work fast enough that it stops occupying the whole of a child's attention. No external examiner is involved yet, which is precisely why this is the cheap time to build the habits.

Grade 9 is where the syllabus begins and where content gaps should be caught. A student who is quietly weak at algebraic manipulation in September will be visibly weak at it in the mock, and the repair costs far less now than then.

Grade 10 is execution. Past papers, timing, mark schemes, and a revision order set by where the marks sit rather than by textbook chapter order.

After Grade 10 comes A Level or a Diploma Programme, and both raise the stakes on exactly the same habits. A student who has learned to answer the command word and show working arrives in Grade 11 with something genuinely portable. A student who learned to memorise model answers does not.
items: Lower secondary: reading stamina, writing length, number fluency
Grade 9: catch content gaps while repair is cheap
Grade 10: past papers, timing, mark-scheme order
Habits carry forward into A Level and Diploma study
Memorised model answers stop working after Grade 10

contentBlocks.heading: Sector 14 Gurugram students travel out to school, and it costs an hour
contentBlocks.body:
An IGCSE student living here is almost certainly commuting. Scottish High International School, Lancers International School, Pathways World School and GD Goenka World School sit at various points around the city, and the bus route from the older sectors is rarely a short one. An hour each way is a normal figure, and it is the single biggest constraint on when tutoring can realistically happen.

IB Gram holds no affiliation with any of these schools. We take no referrals from them, receive no student lists, and no tutor is ever described to you as belonging to a school.

In practice, a child arriving home at half past four has already been out for nine or ten hours. A seven o'clock session works. A five o'clock session, straight off the bus with the uniform still on, usually does not, whatever the weekly plan says.

The commute has a second effect that parents notice later. Classmates are scattered across Gurugram rather than living on the same street, so informal group study is harder to arrange than it would be at a neighbourhood school. Some families pair two children from the same school for one online session a week. Others leave sessions individual and accept the cost.
items: Roughly an hour each way to the international schools
IB Gram is independent of every school named here
Post-bus sessions before 6 pm rarely work
Classmates live across the city, not on your street
Paired online sessions as an occasional workaround

contentBlocks.heading: Checks that happen before a name reaches you
contentBlocks.body:
Verified is a word used loosely in this market, so here is what it covers on this platform.

Government photo identification is confirmed. Degree and institution are confirmed with years attended, along with any teaching qualification claimed.

Then the check that matters most for a family in this part of Gurugram, given the local tuition market described earlier: which examined syllabus has this person actually taught, in which series, and to how many students. Board experience is confirmed at code level rather than accepted as a general claim about international curricula. Somebody with fifteen years of strong Class 10 board teaching and no examined IGCSE cohort behind them is recorded exactly that way, and you get to see it before deciding.

A worked explanation is requested. Where a tutor has taught privately before, a marked script is requested too, because the annotation on it says more about their teaching than the qualification does.

contentBlocks.heading: Where this platform's usefulness stops

A matching service is useful for a narrow job and useless for several others, and knowing that boundary saves money.

Useful: finding somebody who has taught your child's exact syllabus, confirming what they claim, and checking they are actually free when you need them.

Not useful: fixing a student who does no work between sessions. Two hours a week with the strongest available tutor cannot compensate for a fortnight of untouched past papers. This is the most common reason tutoring fails in Gurugram, and it is rarely the tutor's fault.

Also not useful: replacing a conversation with the school. Where a child is struggling across five subjects simultaneously, the problem is usually not five separate subject gaps. It is sleep, or attention, or something happening in a classroom, and hiring tutors is an expensive way of avoiding that discovery.

No grade is promised anywhere on this page. No success rate is quoted and no testimonials appear, because none of them could be substantiated by anyone reading this.
